items.name: Obstig Rote Äpfel
items.description: Two chunky coral-red apples, one stacked in front of the other, with a dark top dimple, brown stems and a leaf-green leaf. Radial-gradient 3D look, natural proportions, generic German red apples.

items.name: Chikita Bananen
items.label: CHIKITA
items.description: Parody of Chiquita bananas: a bunch of three fat curved sun-yellow bananas on a brown crown with the typical blue oval sticker, here saying CHIKITA. Natural proportions.

items.name: Frischewerk Möhren
items.description: Chunky cobalt-blue standing bag of Möhren (carrots) with a crimped top seal, three leaf-green carrot tops poking out and a cream label with one big orange carrot.

items.name: Tannenblick Brokkoli
items.description: One big broccoli head: a bumpy crown of shaded leaf-green florets on a thick lime stalk. Natural proportions, generic German broccoli.
